title: Climate Mod
description: The climate mod for the map's reference height and scale: texturing (the material tree paints the preset's surfaces - meadow, fields, rock, scree, snow, painted water, shore, riverbed, waterfalls - at real elevations), vegetation (the import tree places forest by the forest layer, species by biome and height, and boulders), the climate definition, economy, waterfall brushes and the mod package.

climate_reference_step_m.description: the climate mod's reference height = the lowest land rounded to this step (0 = exact)
